results.title: Manipur cap 42nd Sub Junior National Swimming Championship 2026 campaign with 12 medals
results.description: Manipur swimming team brought home 12 medals from the 42nd Sub Junior National Swimming Championship 2026 that concluded yesterday at Jaipur Manipur's medal haul includes 1 gold, 8 silver and 3 bronze medals David Sapam produced a standout performance to win five individual medals including a gold medal while sharing a silver and a bronze medal in the relay events David Sapam, who competed in the Boys Group II U 15 category, bagged the individual gold medal in the 100m Butterfly event with a time of 59 50 seconds He settled for silver medals in 50m Butterfly event with a time of 27 12 seconds, 200m Butterfly event in 2 10 92, 400m Freestyle event in 4 16 86 and 200m Freestyle event in 2 02 82 Koijam Athoiba and Laitonjam Punghen also bagged two medals apiece in individual events as Th Mangalsana bagged one Competing in the Boys' Group II U 15 category, Koijam Athoiba bagged a silver medal in the 100m Freestyle yesterday with a time of 56 05 seconds as Abdul Hafeez of Tamil Nadu 54 87 s and Anurag Chauhan of SSCB 56 46 s made the 1 3 podium finishes Athoiba had earlier registered a bronze medal to his name in the 50m Freestyle by finishing third in 26 seconds Punghen meanwhile registered two silver medals by finishing second in 100m Butterfly 1 05 18 and 200m Individual Medley 2 31 75 events for Group III boys Th Magalsana added a bronze medal to State's tally yesterday with a time of 2 15 80 in 200m Butterfly event for Group II U 15 boys The 4 100m Medley Relay team comprising Koijam Athoiba, David Sapam, Leishangthem Bishorjit, Nongmaithem Dhananjoy also won a silver medal with a time of 4 17 15 and a bronze medal in the 4 100m Freestyle Relay event with a time of 3 52 41 The State team were led by Laitonjam Santosh as coach and Laitonjam Kanta as manager Notably Karnataka emerged overall team champions with a haul of 10 gold, 10 silver and 19 bronze medals Source The Sangai Express

results.title: MSKA to conduct State Junior Girls' team trial
results.description: The Manipur State Kabaddi Association MSKA is set to conduct State trial cum final selection in connection with the 52nd Junior Girls 8217 National Kabaddi Championship 2026 due to be held from November 26 to 29 at Nehru Stadium, Faridkot, Punjab The trial selection will be held on August 16 at 1 pm at ALUC playground, Khurai Angom Leikai, said MSKA in a circular issued in this regard MSKA also issued a list of 44 players shortlisted to attend the trial Further details can be had from the office of the association Source The Sangai Express

results.title: 43rd MSBA Inter District and 70th State Open Badminton Championships underway
results.description: The 43rd edition of the MSBA Inter District and 70th edition of State Open Badminton Championships organised by the Manipur State Badminton Association kicked off today at MSBA Indoor Stadium, DMU Campus B State Open B br br The opening day saw commencement of U13 Boys' singles competition U11 Boys singles competition In the first Round of 64 match for U13 Boys, Salam Yohenba Singh outlasted Bhavesh Rudra Sanglakpam 15 7 15 17 15 4 before Imareldra Laishram got the better of Meethoiba Chongtham 15 4 15 5 and Riyosnganba Soubam beat Polem Lamyanba 15 1 15 3 in the second and third matches In the fourth Round of 64 match, Heriquesh Khangembam beat Vian Angom 15 11 14 16 15 11 before Dhanaraj Singam beat Dedric Sarangthem 15 6 15 4 and Naorem Nelson Singh beat Kangabam Sinheiba Mangang 15 1 15 3 in the fifth and sixth matches In the other round of 64 matches, Rojesh Mayanglambam beat Birsingh Konthoujam 15 10 15 8 Burcelee Chingtham beat Worlanso Kasar 15 8 18 16 Laishram Bekeson Singh fought back to seal a 10 15 20 18 15 10 win over Yengkhom Chingkheinganba Singh Ahen Sinam Thingbaijam edged out Lucky Khuman 13 15 15 12 15 6 Hercules Laishram beat Chinglemba Yumnam 15 4 15 12 and Rajkumar Bhumikanta eased past Krish Gurung 15 5 15 9 In four Round of 32 matches of U11 Boys singles competition, Khundrakpam Narjit Singh overwhelmed Birsingh Konthoujam 15 4 10 15 15 11 Paleppa Soubam beat Th Rengningam 15 7 15 4 Tayenjam Sanjoo Singh beat Sarungbam Yoihen 15 8 15 6 and Allyster Laishram Urush Thiyam 15 6 15 5 B MSBA Inter District Badminton B br br The opening day also saw Senapati, Thoubal and Imphal West teams advance to semi finals of the men's team championship In the second quarterfinal match, Senapati team beat Manipur Police 3 0 before Thoubal team outlasted Kakching and Imphal West team thumped Imphal East team in the same fashion In the women's team championship, Imphal West team eased past Senapati team 3 0 in a lopsided semi final match to set up a final date with Bishnupur team Source The Sangai Express

results.title: NSA greets N Tomchou on clinching gold at Asian Junior weightlifting championship
results.description: The management, coaches, teachers and staff of the National Sports Academy NSA have extended heartfelt congratulations to Nameirakpam Tomchou on winning a gold medal at the Asian Junior Weightlifting Championship hosted by Uzbekistan in Tashkent Tomchou, son of Nameirakpam Amuba and Nameirakpam Ibemu of Ngairangbam Awang Leikai, claimed the Asian Junior Championship 60 kg category title by lifting a combined total of 266 kg Snatch 116 kg bronze medal in the segment and Clean Jerk 150 kg a silver medal in the segment br br table align center cellpadding 5 width 610 tbody tr td table class capbox width 100 tbody tr td img width 600 src https www e pao org galleries images News Related 2026 08 Tomchou 20260811 jpg border 1 alt NSA greets N Tomchou on clinching gold at Asian Junior weightlifting championship td tr tr td align center NSA greets N Tomchou on clinching gold at Asian Junior weightlifting championship td tr tbody table td tr tbody table br br He had also won a gold medal at the Commonwealth Youth Junior Championships held earlier this year at Apia, Samoa, said NSA in a press release Tomchou is an alumni of the academy, who was admitted in 2017 and passed out from the academy in 2024 He received training under the supervision and guidance of coaches Chanambam Premita and Takhellambam Bobo during his 7 year tenure, it added NSA also extended more success in his future endeavours Source The Sangai Express

results.title: Chief Minister fetes CWG medallist Chanambam Rishikanta
results.description: Chief Minister of Manipur Yumnam Khemchand Singh today feted Commonwealth Games Weightlifting silver medallist Chanambam Rishikanta Singh 60 kg category at Chief Minister's Secretariat, Imphal While felicitating the medallist, the Chief Minister extended his heartfelt congratulations to Chanambam Rishikanta Singh for his outstanding performance at the recently held 23rd edition of Commonwealth Games 2026 at Glasgow, Scotland His achievement has brought laurels to both the State and the Nation and makes the State proud, said the Chief Minister at the occasion br br table align center cellpadding 5 width 610 tbody tr td table class capbox width 100 tbody tr td img width 600 src https www e pao org galleries images News Related 2026 08 Rishikanta 20260811 jpg border 1 alt Chief Minister fetes CWG medallist Chanambam Rishikanta td tr tr td align center Chief Minister fetes CWG medallist Chanambam Rishikanta td tr tbody table td tr tbody table br br Lauding the sports movement in Manipur, the Chief Minister informed that the State Government has considered enhancing the incentives given to the medallists in international and national competitions Most of the sportspersons who brought medals belong to lower income groups of families and despite the hardship they faced, they strive to bring laurels for the state and the Nation, he added He further said that perseverance and hard work are the prerequisites of being a sportsperson Manipur has a tradition and culture of supporting sportspersons by the local clubs and the community, whereas such culture is not prevalent in other regions outside Manipur, he said During the interaction with the Chief Minister, Chanambam Rishikanta Singh expressed his profound gratitude for the Chief Minister's encouragement and motivational guidance Taking an example of himself winning a silver medal, he said that especially those sportspersons belonging to lower income groups of families should not be disheartened if they cannot afford the diet required for a sportsperson, and this wrong perception needs to be dispelled He continued that he would bring more success in the future The YAS Minister Govindas Konthoujam, MLAs Dr Sapam Ranjan Singh, Th Radheshyam, P Brojen Singh, T Robindro, Sheikh Noorul Hassan, Janghemlung Panmei, Th Shyamkumar Singh, Th Raghumani Singh, Secretary YAS, N Praveen, and the parents of Chanambam Rishikanta Singh were present during the felicitation ceremony Source The Sangai Express DIPR
